quest_categories.name: Town Help Wanted Board
quest_categories.location: Oakhaven Town Square (In front of Maeve's Town Hall)
quest_categories.description: Everyday community requests, lost items, crop supplies, and comfort dishes yielding +100 Friendship Points.

quest_categories.name: Delvers' Lodge Bounty Board
quest_categories.location: Cavern Mine Elevator Outpost (Knight Marlo & Bram)
quest_categories.description: Monster extermination bounties and perilous deep ore extractions, awarding Delver's Crests and guild rank.

quest_categories.name: Hearth Eatery Weekly Catering Orders
quest_categories.location: The Hearth Eatery & Tavern (Loft R&D Workbench)
quest_categories.description: Large-scale weekly feasts and expedition field rations, granting massive coin revenue and exclusive recipes.

quests.title: Grandmother Maeve's Warm Dinner
quests.description: My old knee joints are aching too fiercely in this damp wind to bend down in the garden. Could you spare 3 fresh carrots for tonight's stew?
quests.dialogue_complete: Such a thoughtful soul, Rowan! The fragrant earth on these fresh roots reminds me so warmly of dear Amalia.

quests.title: Sylvan's Restorative Broth
quests.description: The chill mist last evening brought back my chest cough; my trembling fingers can barely strike a match. Might the tavern have a hot bowl of liquorice chicken broth to spare?
quests.dialogue_complete: One hot spoonful and warmth flows straight through weary veins. Your kitchen is truly a blessing upon this valley.

quests.title: Clara's Lost Botanical Sketchbook
quests.description: While sketching dusk near Whisperwood Cascade, a cheeky squirrel snatched my ancestral heraldry book! Please help me find it — the library floor plans are inside...
quests.dialogue_complete: Ah! My sketches! The ink isn't smudged at all! Thank you so very much, Rowan!

quests.title: Post-Storm Bridge Reinforcement
quests.description: Last night's flash storm fractured two support beams on the brook bridge. I urgently need 25 solid oak planks to secure the footings before merchant wagons stall.
quests.dialogue_complete: Sturdy, seasoned timber — Rowan's trademark quality! Oakhaven stays connected thanks to your steady back.

quests.title: Winter Berry Preserves for Hazel
quests.description: Winter is closing in and our ranch pantry shelves are almost bare. Could you gather 8 ripe wild berry clusters so Hazel can boil up preserves for the village kids?
quests.dialogue_complete: Look at those plump, ruby-red berries! Swing by the pastures this afternoon and Hazel will send you home with fresh butter and warm jam!

quests.title: Bounty: Deep Crag Cave Spiders
quests.description: Venomous crag spiders have webbed over the ore cart rails on Floor 25, menacing young delvers. Venture deep and eliminate 15 to clear the way.
quests.dialogue_complete: Clean, disciplined blade work, comrade! The lodge honors your valor with these insignia crests.

quests.title: Emergency Delivery: Furnace Coal
quests.description: The deep shaft cage is burning through steam coal at double speed. Bring up 20 lumps of dense anthracite from Floor 10+ to keep pressure in the hoist.
quests.dialogue_complete: Hahaha! High-carbon black gold! The steam pistons are humming again. Tonight's tavern pint is on old Bram!

quests.title: Herb Procurement: Luminous Fungi
quests.description: Treating deep-strata Blight toxins requires fresh luminous fungus clusters harvested around subterranean pools below Floor 40. True delver territory.
quests.dialogue_complete: Freshly harvested and gleaming with azure phosphorescence. This antidote batch will save countless rookie miners.

quests.title: Slay Stratum Warden: Blighted Ancient Treant
quests.description: The Floor 40 gatekeeper has awakened. Corrupted roots are choking the underground river. A fearless vanguard is needed to sever its shadowy core.
quests.dialogue_complete: Incredible... you stood toe-to-toe with the Warden and prevailed! Your name shall be engraved upon the lodge honor roll!

quests.title: Grand Welcome Feast for Garrick's Fleet
quests.description: This Sunday our five merchant caravels drop anchor laden with exotic spices. The famished crews need 8 steaming pans of fragrant saffron seafood paella.
quests.dialogue_complete: By the sea sirens! That sizzling seafood aroma has the deckhands cheering! Here is our caravel's private spiced rum distillation recipe!

quests.title: Subterranean Rescue Expedition Rations
quests.description: Blizzard conditions have forced our rescue squad into a 72-hour deep cavern search. We need 15 dense, calorie-heavy rations that won't freeze solid in sub-zero drafts.
quests.dialogue_complete: Incredible fuel — sustained every rescuer through sub-zero drafts and brought four trapped miners out alive. This heavy insulated pack is yours!
